title: The Air Tariff Eviction
logline: A station clinic doctor suspects station managers are intentionally venting oxygen to manufacture a life-support shortage, using soaring air tariffs to evict impoverished tenants.

roles.description: Chief medical officer of the lower-deck charity clinic; exhausted, angry, treating hundreds of children suffering from hypoxic fatigue.
Oversees the life support distribution grid; smooth, defensive, blaming reactor wear for oxygen surcharges.
The collective of lower-deck residential families refusing to pay emergency life support surcharges.
The private corporate landlord entity controlling residential leases and atmospheric recycling on the station.
The overcrowded medical shelter on the lower residential ring, running on portable emergency oxygen bottles.
The restricted industrial level housing the station's massive carbon-scrubbing turbines and liquid gas reservoirs.
The luxurious high-pressure executive hub at the station core where atmosphere is filtered and scented.

public_situation: Emergency life-support surcharges triple on lower decks across {system}, sparking rent strikes while {role:clinic_module} overflows with hypoxic patients.
private_truth: {role:utility_director} is venting breathable gas into industrial storage pods to create an artificial shortage, pricing lower-deck families into mass eviction.

beats.public_change: The management trust posts eviction warrants across four residential rings for tenants who defaulted on the new oxygen tariff.

missions.reason: She needs high-purity medical oxygen bottles purchased from an unaligned fuel refinery to keep infant incubators running in the clinic.
missions.private_fact: She is paying for the oxygen with unminted dental gold scavenged from miners who died under her care.

beats.public_change: Management cuts ventilation fans in Sector Four, declaring the atmosphere non-compliant with commercial habitability standards.

missions.reason: She needs the pilot to scan the exhaust manifolds on the scrubber level and verify that pure oxygen is being shunted into private reserve tanks.
missions.private_fact: Her own nephew works as an apprentice mechanic on the scrubber deck and slipped her the manifold schematics.

beats.public_change: Private security seals the central elevator shaft, barring tenant representatives from entering the appeals office.

missions.reason: She needs the physical flow-meter recording drive retrieved from the scrubber maintenance locker before security wipes the telemetry.
missions.private_fact: The drive also contains proof that the executive tower has been enjoying double the legal oxygen allocation.

beats.public_change: Thousands of suffocating tenants gather outside the management tower as security lines draw stun batons.

missions.reason: She needs the verified flow logs delivered into the emergency arbitration session to force an immediate restoration of life support.
missions.private_fact: {role:utility_director} is offering the pilot a thirty-year free residential lease in the luxury tower to destroy the drive.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the telemetry showing the oxygen was deliberately hoarded to evict the poor. Who gets the record?

options.label: Broadcast the telemetry to the tenants' union and council
Take the luxury penthouse lease and hand the drive to the director
Force a private rebate for the clinic while leaving general tariffs in place

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot presents the flow meter logs to the council and tenants.
resolutions.summary: The manufactured shortage is exposed. Emergency tariffs are repealed, {role:utility_director} is dismissed, and full ventilation is restored to the lower decks.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot uncovered evidence that landlords were hoarding life-support oxygen to evict working families.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the penthouse lease and surrenders the drive.
resolutions.summary: The evidence is incinerated. {role:utility_director} executes mass evictions across four decks, converting the empty sectors into high-rent automated warehouses.

consequences.public_summary: Rumors swirl that a pilot traded proof of life-support extortion for a private penthouse suite in the core.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a quiet oxygen supply deal solely for the clinic.
resolutions.summary: The clinic receives free oxygen bottles, but the wider tariffs remain. Lower decks are gradually cleared of residents as families run out of scrip.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the contract or fails the mission line.
resolutions.summary: Suffocating tenants surrender their keys. Over eight hundred families are put on cargo shuttles to the rim, and the management trust secures complete control.

loose_threads.detail: The shipping logs on the industrial gas tanks indicate they were sold forward to an off-station mining syndicate at three times domestic rates.
The central atmospheric purity monitor runs software modified with an electronic key belonging to an executive holding firm.
The quarterly habitability inspection for the lower decks was signed by an inspector whose official badge expired four years ago.

radio_hooks: Life support utility director denies claims of deliberate oxygen rationing on residential rings.
Lower deck medical clinics report acute oxygen shortages as respiratory hospitalizations climb.
Tenant unions stage peaceful sit-ins outside municipal environmental engineering offices.

voice_direction.district_physician: Exhausted, sharp, and incandescent with rage. Spits medical statistics like accusations, pausing occasionally to catch her own breath in the thinning air.
voice_direction.utility_director: Pompous, condescending, and smoothly unruffled. Speaks in the patient, patronizing tone of a senior accountant explaining fiscal reality to unruly debtors.
